sections.content: The plan vdd-conformance-exact-cover is implementation-authorized and self-hosted. It preserves and hardens typed package selection, produces a source-freeze manifest, implements deterministic exact cover, semantic handoff, retry taxonomy, shard reuse, bounded recovery context, preflight checks, and terminal dogfood replay. Changes are restricted to listed skill and test paths.
sections.title: Implementation contract

sections.content: The normative universe is the typed Canonical Spec Package graph and adopted Architecture Spine. Requirements are exactly VCEC-001 through VCEC-036 and acceptances VCEC-A01 through VCEC-A43, with authoritative forward and reverse mappings and registered commands. VDD artifacts keep authorizes empty. Listed non-goals exclude producer attestation, lifecycle ownership, copied schemas, Chapter 5 dependency, automatic Bootstrap launch, and Codex resume guarantees.
sections.title: Requirements and acceptance

sections.content: Both manifest sources are included with complete page content coverage: implementation-contract.v1.json and requirements-and-acceptance.md. No source or page coverage is omitted.
